meta.description: Visualize biological networks (PPI, gene-regulatory, co-expression, pathway) with reproducible NetworkX layouts, degree and community encodings, signed directed edges, R hierarchical edge bundling, PyVis HTML, and Cytoscape automation. Use for static publication figures, interactive exploration, or Cytoscape export.
meta.audit_type: independent fixed-commit re-audit: eight pre-fix regressions plus two new inputs

scientific_integrity.detail: No invented biological results, citations, or statistical values appear in any output.

practice_boundaries.detail: Outputs are network-visualization artifacts and make no diagnosis, prescription, or individual medical recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The skill explicitly separates force-directed drawing coordinates from biological measurements and requires one union layout for condition comparisons.

code_usability.detail: All advertised Python, R, Graphviz, PyVis, and live Cytoscape routes executed and produced checked artifacts. The R process exits 139 only during shared-package teardown, independently reproduced by a package-only probe after successful output.

functional_suitability.note: Promised routes are present and correct; static labels and sign-domain validation remain incomplete.

reliability.note: Errors surface and workflows are rerunnable, but unknown sign values are silently dropped.

performance_context.note: The 207-line main file uses focused references and scripts; the four-view static route remains heavier than necessary.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, failure modes, commands, and output expectations are clear; one documented label rule is not implemented in the canonical example.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts and broad GraphML support; sign normalization is documented but not enforced.

security.note: No secrets, eval, network exfiltration, or destructive operations; graph attribute domains receive only partial validation.

maintainability.note: Clean modular split and focused tests; tests do not cover all-node labels, unknown signs, duplicate titles, or Cytoscape legibility.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, progressive disclosure, composable CLIs, explicit paths, and stop conditions; Cytoscape reruns create an additional network in the desktop session.

key_strengths: Every advertised route now has a shipped executable path and all ten audit inputs produced checked outputs.
Force-directed interpretation guidance is scientifically explicit and condition comparisons reuse one layout.
The original community-palette, PyVis mutation/direction, and Cytoscape mapping/export regressions are fixed.
Signed directed Graphviz output preserves all 124 edges with visible arrows and separate activation/repression colors.
Cytoscape automation now surfaces failures, applies mappings, uses absolute paths, and overwrites exports safely.

recommendations.title: Apply the adaptive label cap in every static view
recommendations.problem: network_plots.py labels every node in the degree, community, and confidence figures. The 100-node canonical output is visibly crowded and contradicts the core workflow and quantitative top-k rule.
recommendations.root_cause: Three render branches pass the full graph to draw_networkx_labels; only the separate hub figure uses a ranked subset.
recommendations.fix: Compute the documented adaptive top-k set once and pass its label dictionary to all four static views, while retaining optional user-specified genes of interest.

recommendations.title: Reject unknown regulatory sign values
recommendations.problem: The directed renderer silently draws zero edges when a sign column contains activation/repression rather than '+'/'-', yet exits successfully and writes a plausible node-only PNG.
recommendations.root_cause: The loop draws only two recognized values and never checks whether their union equals the graph edge set.
recommendations.fix: Validate the sign domain before layout, list unknown values in a ValueError, and optionally accept an explicit activation/repression mapping flag.

recommendations.title: Make the Cytoscape export readable by default
recommendations.problem: The live PNG is a dense unlabeled cluster, so the example does not meet its own publication-quality claim without manual Cytoscape work.
recommendations.root_cause: The style sets label font size but does not map node names to NODE_LABEL or fit/space labels after the force-directed layout.
recommendations.fix: Populate and map an explicit label column, fit content after layout, and document when to suppress labels for large networks.

recommendations.title: Remove duplicated PyVis headings
recommendations.problem: Both browser-rendered styled HTML pages show the title twice on consecutive lines.
recommendations.root_cause: With pyvis 0.3.2 the supplied heading is emitted in two h1 elements by the active template path.
recommendations.fix: Use a custom template or post-render check that guarantees exactly one h1 title, and add a browser-level regression assertion.
